subject: Request: Replenish expired trial credit & expedite procurement
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria@nimbusanalytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Trial credits expired — urgent PO + request for short bridge

Hi Ben (and Aisha),

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency profile looks promising for our real-time scoring use case. We started the sandbox two weeks ago but ran into a billing/PO delay on our side. Our sandbox credits expired overnight and that has blocked the last set of evaluation tests needed before procurement signs the PO.

Procurement timeline: we expect an internal PO to be issued by next week (target 06/09) but we need an extra ~2,000 token-equivalent credit to finish the burst of tests and validate the integration with our feature store. Is Redwood able to provide a one-time, short-term credit extension or goodwill top-up while our PO goes through approvals? If useful I can attach our internal vendor onboarding docs and SOC2 summary — attaching SOC2-Summary.pdf.

Our procurement contact is procurement@nimbusanalytics.com (I copied them on follow-up). If a limited extension is possible, we can prioritize the contract and send a formal PO immediately. Appreciate any help — we want to keep momentum.

Best,
Maria Lopez
Head of Data Platform
Nimbus Analytics

Attachment: SOC2-Summary.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria@nimbusanalytics.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial credits expired — urgent PO + request for short bridge

Hi Maria — thanks for the note and the SOC2 doc. Glad the demo landed.

Quick ask to help us expedite: can you confirm the procurement lead's email and the expected PO amount and date? We have a standard mutual action plan we use in these situations to make the handoff to billing/legal seamless (MAP-template.xlsx) — I attached that for your procurement team.

We can typically offer a short, one-time sandbox credit to unblock testing, but I need approval from Aisha (sales manager) and confirmation from Soojin in CS on the scope (to avoid open-ended credits). If procurement can provide a PO window (e.g., PO by 06/09 and payment terms net 30), that will help justify a goodwill top-up.

Proposed short-term options (for transparency):
- Option A: 2,000 token-equivalent sandbox credit (one-time) — requires sales manager approval
- Option B: 1,200 token-equivalent credit + prioritized onboarding support from CS (faster integration)

Let me know which option procurement prefers; Aisha/Soojin — can you weigh in?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP-template.xlsx (attachment stub)

From: Maria Lopez <maria@nimbusanalytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@nimbusanalytics.com
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial credits expired — urgent PO + request for short bridge

Ben / Aisha — thanks for the quick reply. Procurement contact is: Lara Chen <procurement@nimbusanalytics.com>. Expected PO amount: $28,000 (covers 3 months of expected usage). Internal approvals are in final review and we anticipate PO issuance by 2027-06-09 EOD.

Given the timeline, Option A (2,000 tokens) would be ideal — that would let our engineers complete the throughput tests and confirm vendor selection in the same week. If necessary we can accept Option B with the support guarantee.

I've attached a scanned PO pre-approval summary (Nimbus_PO_20270601.pdf) and re-attached SOC2-Summary.pdf for quick reference. Can you confirm whether Redwood needs a signed order form or if the PO alone is sufficient? Procurement prefers to avoid additional paperwork if possible.

Thanks again — we can get the formal PO in immediately once we have confirmation the sandbox will be provisioned.

Best,
Maria

Attachments: Nimbus_PO_20270601.pdf (attachment stub), SOC2-Summary.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria@nimbusanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial credits expired — urgent PO + request for short bridge

Hi Maria — thanks for including the procurement contact and PO summary.

We generally approve one-time sandbox extensions for active procurement windows. I want to confirm two things before we provision:
1) Can you confirm the specific evaluation tests that require the extra tokens (rough outline is fine)? We use that to scope support resources.
2) Will Nimbus accept an adjustment in billing where we hold invoices until the PO is signed?

If the answers are yes -> I will request a one-time 2,000 token sandbox extension from sales leadership. I flagged this as "procurement-driven short top-up" in our CS playbook. See internal playbook: https://redwood-internal/playbooks/cs/sandbox-extensions (for internal reference).

On support: if you choose Option B, we can assign a solutions engineer to be on a short call within 48 hours.

Thanks — looping Ben and Aisha for approvals.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maria Lopez <maria@nimbusanalytics.com>, procurement@nimbusanalytics.com
Date: Sat, 5 Jun 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial credits expired — urgent PO + request for short bridge

Thanks for the context, team. Approving a one-time credit to keep the evaluation moving — however, given our policy and to balance fairness across pilots, I will authorize 1,200 token-equivalent sandbox credit for Nimbus immediately.

Conditions:
- This is a one-time, non-recurring top-up tied to deal NIM-PO-202706.
- Billing will be placed on hold pending receipt of the formal PO by 2027-06-09 EOD. If the PO is not received by that date, any usage beyond the 1,200 token top-up will be billed per standard terms.
- CS to provide prioritized 2-hour onboarding session within 72 hours of credit provisioning.

Ben — please mark this approved in the deal record (HubSpot) and coordinate with billing to hold invoices. Soojin — please provision the 1,200 credits and schedule the onboarding. Maria — if procurement can still push the PO by 06/09 that would allow us to convert this to normal billing.

I'll capture the approval note and attach a short approval stub to the deal.

Regards,
Aisha Rahman
Sales Manager, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachment: approval-notes.txt (internal approval stub)

From: Maria Lopez <maria@nimbusanalytics.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Lara Chen <procurement@nimbusanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial credits expired — urgent PO + request for short bridge

Aisha / Ben / Soojin — this is fantastic, thank you. We accept the 1,200 token extension and appreciate the onboarding offer — that will get our engineers across the finish line. Procurement will push the PO to you by 06/09 as requested.

I'll follow up with a short email to procurement to confirm the PO route and attach the scanned pre-approval. Thanks again for the quick turnaround — excited to move forward.

Best,
Maria Lopez
Head of Data Platform
Nimbus Analytics

Attachment: Nimbus_PO_20270601.pdf (re-attached)
